text: Construction on the Port Union Road widening project is underway. Transportation Services staff are recommending additional minor changes to Port Union Road to enhance safety and operations.

City Council on April 17 and 18, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate a two-way centre left-turn only lane on Port Union Road, between a point 58 metres south of Island Road and Dear Gate. 2. City Council prohibit eastbound right-turns on red signal at all times at the intersection of Lawrence Avenue East and Port Union Road, bicycles excepted.
